title: How to Find the GTA6 Giant Crab Safe Code and Crabshack VF5 SMG
description: Discover the GTA6 giant crab event! Learn how to navigate the Pelican Valley Outpost, find the safe code, and unlock the Crabshack VF5 SMG.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Uncovering the GTA6 Giant Crab Event and Rewards

Open-world exploration in *GTA6* continues to offer surprising and unique experiences for players scouring the map. According to a recent report from gaming media outlet Polygon, a special giant crab event takes players on an intriguing adventure, culminating in an impressive and standout weapon reward.

## Pelican Valley Outpost and the Safe Code

The event famously guides players into the **Pelican Valley Outpost**. Within this specific location, participants are tasked with tracking down the giant crab safe code. Environmental puzzles and hidden collectibles have always been a staple of Rockstar Games' design philosophy, encouraging players to thoroughly investigate their surroundings to progress through these unique regional happenings.

## Claiming the Crabshack VF5 SMG

Successfully navigating the event and cracking the safe yields a fantastic reward: the **Crabshack VF5 SMG**. Standing out as a unique addition to the game's arsenal, this weapon serves as a great incentive for completionists and players looking to bolster their loadout with special gear found during world events.

## Editor's Take

We love seeing Rockstar inject this kind of playful, offbeat personality into *GTA6*. Blending quirky regional themes with tangible gameplay rewards like the Crabshack VF5 SMG makes exploring the map feel genuinely rewarding. It's well worth checking out the Pelican Valley Outpost for a break from the main hustle.
